name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
description: Salesforce Commerce Cloud offers B2C and B2B commerce platforms with headless APIs, SDKs and CLI.
auth_notes: SCAPI uses JWT access tokens as Bearer headers; Shopper APIs via SLAS (OAuth 2.1), Admin APIs via Account Manager API client.
gate_detail: Requires a B2C Commerce instance and an Account Manager API client. Demo sandbox and on-demand sandbox exist. API is at no extra cost for B2C Commerce customers.
api_scope: SCAPI Shopper and Admin RESTful APIs, legacy OCAPI, Custom APIs, Node.js and React SDKs and a Commerce Cloud CLI.
mcp_notes: Sources show a Salesforce MCP blog but no Commerce Cloud-specific server.
blocker_detail: Needs a licensed B2C Commerce instance and Account Manager admin to create API clients.

evidence.quote: Both the Admin and Shopper APIs are authorized using an access token in the form of a JSON Web Token (JWT).
Create an API client in Account Manager
For B2C Commerce customers, the API is available at no extra cost.
If you don't have a B2C Commerce instance, try the demo sandbox used in the example above.
The B2C Commerce API (SCAPI) is a set of RESTful APIs for building storefronts, merchant tools, and integrations on the B2C Commerce platform.
Use a headless API to build custom apps.

issues: Licensing cost of a B2C instance not stated.
Webhooks only mentioned for Point of Sale.
No Commerce Cloud MCP server found in sources.
